notes.title: Environment Update
notes.notes:
Rumours have been circulating that the "Return to Nangrim" project has been abandoned, but we want to clarify things and share some news. We are heavily focused on developing the survival and sandbox mechanics, including mining, brewing, crafting, chopping, harvesting, and other nature-related elements. 🏔️⛏️🍻⚒️

We're also working on implementing a dynamic environment, and continuous calendar with moon phases and celestial mechanics. We assure you that the project is actively being developed, and you don't have to worry about its progress.

To give you a glimpse of what we've been working on, we've released a video showcasing the nature around the main mountain. This is part of a case study we conducted earlier, and it highlights the soundscape, dynamic nature, and environment.

[previewyoutube=6KWcW_-Wti8;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know your thoughts!
